claim_fixture.text: Structured audit trails make later editorial correction easier to reconstruct.
Rapid drafting increases the importance of keeping evidence relationships inspectable during revision.
Release authority remains distinct from production quality.

artifact_contract.headline: Why evidence lineage matters when professional work moves faster

sections.body: Professional drafting can accelerate while the evidentiary trail becomes harder to inspect unless source relationships are preserved deliberately.
sections.heading: The speed problem

sections.body: A governed editorial workflow should keep claims, supporting sources, contradictions and unresolved questions visible during revision rather than reconstructing them after publication.
sections.heading: Lineage as editorial infrastructure

sections.body: A polished draft may be ready for editorial review while publication remains an explicitly human-authorised act.
sections.heading: Quality is not publication authority

source_fixture.citation: Mokoena, T. (2024). Evidence lineage in professional decision systems. Journal of Applied Governance, 12(2), 44-61.
Naidoo, P. (2025). Human authority in AI-assisted professional workflows. Review of Digital Practice, 8(1), 15-29.

artifact_contract.standfirst: A controlled editorial fixture showing how source provenance and claim boundaries can remain visible while a draft becomes publication-ready.

job.buyer: Professional editor preparing a source-bound article
job.request: Turn these supplied sources into a publication-ready article draft with traceable claims and references.
